title: AutoCAD MCP source-reviewed capability benchmark
methodology: Public source, documented behavior, and locally recorded test evidence scored with a fixed 100-point rubric. Repository stars and raw tool counts do not score points. The U-C4N row was re-scored for 1.6.0 on 2026-09-24 with per-category evidence; competitor rows are their July snapshots and were not re-reviewed.

projects.note: Scored per category, each with its evidence (roadmap criterion 8). 1.4.0 received a single overall 95; this review is stricter, and every point withheld is named. New in 1.5-1.6: P&ID, environment, mechanical, sheet, architecture, understanding and takeoffs; A/B 48/48 with 0 regressions; live COM smokes on every track.

category_scores.evidence: 247 tools: drafting, ISO 129/286/1101 annotation, paper space, styles and page setup, environment, P&ID (ISO 10628-2 / ISA-5.1, read back with confidence), a mechanical part model with standard parts, ISO 5457/7200/7573/6433 sheets, an architectural plan engine, drawing understanding, diff, topology and plant takeoffs. Not covered: electrical schematics, image-to-CAD tracing, Plant 3D, obstacle-avoiding routing, headless REGION/3DSOLID.

A/B gate against v1.5.1: 48/48 checks, 0 regressions (ab-v1.5.1-vs-v1.6.0.json). Matrix v7: 21 tasks whose gates can fail (zero critique issues and a finalize score of at least 90, PDF /MediaBox, rooms within 0.1 %, takeoff lengths exact). drawing_deliver writes a manifest and checks reopen parity. A field test on a real P&ID pair drove nine fixes. Minus: a headless DIMENSION does not re-render, and a takeoff on a real P&ID still needs the engineer's scope decisions.

COM and ezdxf behind one typed contract, with capability-map parity enforced by a test. Every 1.6 track's COM path ran live on AutoCAD 2026. CI runs Linux 3.11/3.12 and Windows. Minus: BricsCAD, ZWCAD and GstarCAD are unverified.

Transcribed standards tables (ISO 4014/4017/4032/7089/4762, ISO 15, ISO 286, ISO 5457, ISO 7200, ISO 7573) and one part model and view engine. 18 domain critique focuses (P&ID 6, mechanical 6, architecture 3, topology 3) feed drawing_finalize's 0-100 score. Minus: four DIN/ISO feature tables ship empty until verified rows exist.

About 4,990 tests on a locked dependency graph. The release gate re-runs three OS/Python lanes; a document-number gate and the per-release A/B suite also run. The perf lane is published (perf-v1.4.0-vs-v1.6.0.json). Minus: entity creation is 1.25x (2,000 lines) and 1.38x (10,000-line roundtrip) slower than v1.4.0, so roadmap criterion 7 is not met.

Per-tool path validation, a loopback-only HTTP bind unless a bearer token is set, the audit middleware, and a field-test script that refuses to write inside the repository. Minus: ALLOWED_PATHS is empty, and so unscoped, by default; command and LISP filtering is a denylist, which is a guardrail rather than a security boundary.
